subject.input_summary: 独立只读审查最后 R-CODEX-CACHE-2 及 stable-hooks-r2.json，核验冻结 SHA、HEAD 和九项方案断言；仅对冻结 shell 语法做无安装、无文件修改的隔离复现。

findings: FAIL C1 implementability: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:94 freezes exact commands, but stable-hooks-r2.json:76 permits recovery after unsuccessful root resolution, contradicting FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:98.

PASS C2 fullintegrity: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:102,130 retain all four directories, mjs/js/py/sh including tests, additions/deletions/content changes, and rejection of symlinks/special files or scan failures.

PASS C3 reviewed-bytebinding: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:108-110 require frozen artifact-byte SHA plus exact source/JS-format/snapshot/config comparisons before installation and after copying; matching scans alone do not approve.

PASS C4 atomic-preservation: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:114-118 specify exclusive private lock, frozen manifest CAS, preservation of other roots, manifest-last publication, exact dead-lock recovery, and reviewed rollback.

FAIL C5 Stop: stable-hooks-r2.json:76 uses cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" without checking git status. In isolated execution of the unchanged command, git returning 128 with empty stdout caused both helper and recovery calls under /bin/sh, /bin/bash and /bin/zsh because cd "" succeeded. This violates FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:98 no-root recovery prohibition and :131 root-resolution failure gate.
PASS C6 CLI-trust: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:96,122 specify exact --verify behavior, full protocol hash, source-only NOT_CHECKED installation/approval, and official exact-command trust/readback.

PASS C7 compatibility: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:124 specifies exact legacy/stable prefix and suffix recognition, three unique Host Launch targets, restricted matcher, approval validation and retained official trust; consistent with host-hook-ready.js:36-44,60-102 interface responsibilities.

PASS C8 executableacceptance: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:128-135 names runnable tests and failure matrices, actual interruption/concurrency checks, mutation and independent review; live evidence remains explicitly outstanding.

PASS C9 scope: FOLLOWUP-PLAN.md:90,137 constrain named changes and require recording newly discovered callers; prohibit mother-checkout hot edits, private model-binding changes, framework template writes and unrelated dirty-file changes.
